reviewItem.question: Does "Metrics name changes: The Prometheus metrics that Crossplane exposes for the controller engine and function response caches have been updated with the addition…" mean a change to protocol-behavior:crossplane|name=prometheus-metric-names (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: Prometheus metric name prefixes were renamed: crossplane_composition_controllers_* to engine_controllers_*, crossplane_composition_watches_* to engine_watches_*, and crossplane_composition_run_function_* to function_run_function_*.
